overview_description.description: KULI provides service ensuring a seamless experience for passengers. Prior to arrival at the station, passengers simply input their station, platform, and coach details, and their chosen porter will be ready and waiting. Additionally, with GPS tracking, the safety of luggage is guaranteed, eliminating the risk of theft.

product.name: Premium Coolie Service
product.description: A service that allows passengers to book porters in advance, ensuring they are ready at the station with details like station, platform, and coach provided.

product.name: GPS Tracking
product.description: A feature that provides real-time tracking of luggage to ensure its safety and prevent theft.

product.name: Digital Platform
product.description: An online platform offering features like multi-language support, estimated time of arrival, porter ratings, and digital payment options.
